rules.first_trigger: 120 s from the first trigger (the live rule)
rules.first_trigger_plus_30s: 120 s from 30 s after the first trigger
rules.strongest_trigger: 120 s from the trigger with the highest STA/LTA in the search window
rules.envelope_peak_minus_30s: 120 s from 30 s before the peak of the smoothed envelope in the 120 s after the first trigger, never before the trigger

settings.earthquake_search: after the origin and within 90 s of the predicted P arrival
